# Bella Luxe Studio

> Nail art studio based in Pflugerville, Texas. Builder gel, gel manicures and hand-painted designs from Bella, plus pedicures by her mom, in a private suite inside Salon Lofts on Stone Hill Dr. Bring the inspiration; she takes her time on every detail.

## Services
- Builder gel & full sets: Builder gel, acrylic, Gel-X and SNS sets in almond, stiletto or short and square. Full sets from $55, fills from $45.
- Gel manicures & French: Glossy gel color on your natural nails, from milky nudes to gold-tipped French. Gel manicures $35.
- Hand-painted nail art: Show her a photo or an idea and Bella paints it by hand, one nail at a time.
- Chrome, cat-eye & 3D: The finishing details: gold chrome edges, cat-eye shimmer, pearls, rhinestones and 3D flowers.
- Pedicures: Pedicures with Bella's mom in the same cozy studio, from a classic gel pedicure to hot stone, paraffin and collagen.
- Lashes, brows & waxing: Eyelash extensions, lash lifts and brow tinting, plus quick waxing to finish the visit.

## About
Bella Luxe Studio is Bella Phan's private nail studio, in Loft 9 inside Salon Lofts Stone Hill Center at 1513 Stone Hill Dr, Pflugerville. In her words, she created it as “a private, luxury space where every client can feel relaxed, cared for, and truly pampered.” One room, one artist, one client at a time. Bella does the nails: builder gel, gel manicures and hand-painted art, from gold-chrome French tips and purple cat-eye almonds to 3D fruit, holiday sweaters and Halloween ghosts. Her mom does the pedicures, which makes it a true family studio. Lashes, brow tinting and waxing round out the menu. Most clients come in because a friend or coworker sent them, and they stay because she listens, takes her time and gets it right. Book online through GlossGenius or give the studio a call.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book at Bella Luxe Studio?
  A: Book online through Bella's GlossGenius page, or call (737) 888-9979. The studio is open Tuesday to Saturday 10:30 am to 7 pm and Sunday 11:30 am to 5 pm, closed Mondays.
- Q: How much is a full set?
  A: Full sets start at $55, builder gel full sets are $60, and fills start at $45. Gel manicures are $35, and nail art adds from $25 depending on the design. The full menu is on the Services page.
- Q: Can I bring a photo of the design I want?
  A: Yes, please do. Clients say whatever style or inspiration they show Bella, she makes it happen. Custom hand-painted art, chrome and 3D details are what she loves doing.
- Q: Do you do pedicures?
  A: Yes. Bella's mom does the pedicures in the same studio, from a $50 classic gel pedicure to hot stone, paraffin and collagen pedicures, so you can book hands and feet together.
- Q: Where is the studio?
  A: Inside Salon Lofts Stone Hill Center, Loft 9, at 1513 Stone Hill Dr, Suite 9, Pflugerville, TX 78660. It's a private suite, so you'll have Bella's full attention.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: The studio runs by appointment so each client gets her full time. Book on GlossGenius or call to ask about an opening today.
